name: STRIDE Summer Stem Cell Research Training (UCR)
org: UC Riverside, Bourns College of Engineering
what_you_do: Do a 5-week summer research training in a UCR lab on stem cells and regenerative medicine. You also attend skills workshops, speaker sessions, career panels and mentoring.
who_can_apply: High school students in the Inland Empire (Riverside and San Bernardino counties) who are older than 16 by the program start date. Southern California permanent residents in Inland Empire school districts are encouraged, especially with a referral from a STEM teacher or a UCR outreach program.
pay_detail: Pay or stipend not stated on the page.
deadline_text: Recruitment starts in the fall before the program. No deadline is posted. The 2026 session ran June 22 to July 24, 2026.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Now button on the STRIDE page. Email stride@engr.ucr.edu or call (951) 827-5190.
notes: Confirm first: one Apply Now button on the page points to an older 2023 form. The page says applicants must be older than 16 by the program start date and states no maximum age. No stipend or cost is stated. Funded through a CIRM grant.
